0022600134.text: Charlotte, 3-1 and first in the Southeast, heads to Detroit for its fifth game of the season on a two-game winning streak, while the Pistons, 3-0 and first in the Central, have won three straight. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), and Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 118-100 in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
